t: Omoide Yokocho: a lively and nostalgic alley in Shinjuku, Tokyo | Japan Experience
s: November 11, 2024 - In the 1960s, construction of the current Shinjuku Station complex razed part of the market area. Then in 1999, a huge fire swept through, destroying many of the tightly packed, ramshackle establishments. However, the resilient Omoide Yokocho was rebuilt, allowing many shops to trace their lineage and traditional recipes back to those early postwar days.
